title: Trait anxiety selectively amplifies reward learning under uncertainty, while N3 sleep attenuates it.
summary: Adaptive learning under uncertainty requires distinguishing random variability (stochasticity) from true environmental change (volatility), yet how trait anxiety and sleep together influence it remains unclear. Across two preregistered experiments, participants completed a probabilistic reversal-learning task that independently manipulated volatility and stochasticity. Hierarchical Bayesian modeling showed that in stable but noisy environments, individuals with higher trait anxiety appeared to treat stochastic fluctuations as indicators of genuine change, resulting in over updating and lower evidence accumulation, while preserving normative trends in volatile environments. In a second experiment combining task performance with overnight sleep electroencephalography, greater N3 sleep was associated with reduced updating and higher evidence accumulation in stable environments among individuals with higher trait anxiety. These findings suggest that trait anxiety selectively alters how uncertainty is computationally represented, while N3 sleep appears to attenuate it. Together, these findings provide a computational framework linking anxiety, sleep, and adaptive learning under uncertainty.

标题：特质焦虑在不确定性下选择性增强奖赏学习，而N3睡眠减弱该效应
摘要：在不确定性下的适应性学习需要区分随机变异（随机性）与真实的环境变化（波动性），然而特质焦虑与睡眠如何共同影响这一过程仍不清楚。通过两项预注册实验，参与者完成了一项概率反转学习任务，该任务独立操纵了波动性和随机性。分层贝叶斯建模显示，在稳定但嘈杂的环境中，特质焦虑较高的个体似乎将随机波动视为真实变化的指标，导致过度更新和证据累积降低，同时在波动环境中保持规范性趋势。在第二项实验中，结合任务表现与整夜睡眠脑电图，较高的N3睡眠与特质焦虑较高个体在稳定环境中更新减少和证据累积增加相关。这些发现表明，特质焦虑选择性地改变不确定性在计算上的表征方式，而N3睡眠似乎减弱这一效应。总之，这些发现提供了一个连接焦虑、睡眠与不确定性下适应性学习的计算框架。
关键词：特质焦虑；不确定性；奖赏学习；N3睡眠；分层贝叶斯建模

title: Lateralized vagal oxytocin receptor signaling separately controls feeding and socioemotional functions via hypothalamic oxytocin neurons.
summary: Oxytocin neurons in the paraventricular hypothalamus (PVHOxt) regulate feeding, anxiety, and social behaviors. Activation of Oxt receptor (Oxtr)-expressing vagal sensory neurons engages these PVHOxt neurons and improves hyperphagic obesity; however, their roles in anxiety and sociability remain unclear. Here, we activated vagal Oxtr-expressing neurons in male mice using a single intraperitoneal (IP) Oxt injection or chemogenetics. IP Oxt reduced anxiety-like behavior, enhanced social interaction, and suppressed feeding while activating both vagal sensory neurons and PVHOxt neurons. These effects were abolished by chemogenetic inhibition of PVHOxt neurons or central Oxtr blockade. Subdiaphragmatic vagotomy revealed lateralized functions: right-side vagotomy eliminated anxiolytic and prosocial effects, whereas left-side vagotomy blocked feeding suppression. Consistently, chemogenetic activation of left-sided neurons suppressed feeding, while right-sided activation reduced anxiety and increased sociability. These findings identify Oxtr-expressing vagal sensory neurons as a major peripheral pathway in which left- and right-sided inputs differentially control feeding and socioemotional behaviors.

标题：迷走神经催产素受体的偏侧化信号通过下丘脑催产素神经元分别调控摄食与社会情绪功能
摘要：下丘脑室旁核催产素神经元（PVHOxt）调控摄食、焦虑和社交行为。激活表达催产素受体（Oxtr）的迷走感觉神经元可调动这些PVHOxt神经元并改善暴食性肥胖；然而，其在焦虑和社交性中的作用尚不清楚。本研究通过单次腹腔注射催产素或化学遗传学方法激活雄性小鼠的迷走Oxtr表达神经元。腹腔注射催产素可降低焦虑样行为、增强社交互动并抑制摄食，同时激活迷走感觉神经元和PVHOxt神经元。化学遗传学抑制PVHOxt神经元或中枢Oxtr阻断可消除这些效应。膈下迷走神经切断术揭示了偏侧化功能：右侧迷走神经切断术消除了抗焦虑和亲社会效应，而左侧迷走神经切断术阻断了摄食抑制。一致地，化学遗传学激活左侧神经元可抑制摄食，而右侧激活则降低焦虑并增加社交性。这些发现表明，表达Oxtr的迷走感觉神经元是一条主要的外周通路，其左侧和右侧输入对摄食和社会情绪行为进行差异性调控。
关键词：催产素；迷走感觉神经元；社会情绪；摄食；偏侧化

title: Robust multimodal emotion recognition under incomplete modalities via transformer conditional variational autoencoders.
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition (MER) has gained increasing research interest owing to its ability to integrate complementary emotional cues from textual, acoustic, and visual modalities. However, real-world applications often suffer from incomplete multimodal inputs caused by sensor failures, communication disruptions, or noisy environments, resulting in missing modalities or corrupted features. To address these challenges, this study proposes RMM-TCVAE, a robust MER framework based on a Transformer-based Conditional Variational Autoencoder. The framework combines modality-specific encoders, a conditional Transformer Reconstruction Network for recovering missing modalities, and a Gated Multimodal Fusion Network for adaptive cross-modal integration. Experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and IEMOCAP demonstrate that RMM-TCVAE consistently outperforms strong baselines under incomplete multimodal conditions, achieving 84.8% accuracy on CMU-MOSEI and yielding improvements of up to 2.9 percentage points in Acc and 3.1 percentage points in WAF across fixed missing-rate experiments. Ablation and visualization analyses support the effectiveness of RMM-TCVAE under incomplete multimodal conditions.

标题：基于Transformer条件变分自编码器的模态不完整条件下鲁棒多模态情绪识别
摘要：多模态情绪识别（MER）因能够整合来自文本、声学和视觉模态的互补情绪线索而受到越来越多的研究关注。然而，现实应用常因传感器故障、通信中断或噪声环境而面临多模态输入不完整的问题，导致模态缺失或特征损坏。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出了RMM-TCVAE，一种基于Transformer条件变分自编码器的鲁棒多模态情绪识别框架。该框架结合了模态特定编码器、用于恢复缺失模态的条件Transformer重建网络，以及用于自适应跨模态整合的门控多模态融合网络。在CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI和IEMOCAP上的实验表明，RMM-TCVAE在不完整多模态条件下持续优于强基线方法，在CMU-MOSEI上达到84.8%的准确率，并在固定缺失率实验中Acc提升最高达2.9个百分点，WAF提升最高达3.1个百分点。消融实验和可视化分析支持了RMM-TCVAE在不完整多模态条件下的有效性。
关键词：多模态情绪识别；条件变分自编码器；Transformer；缺失模态恢复；跨模态融合
